name: streamlit-stock-price
description: A simple Streamlit dashboard that displays stock prices and details of a given company

paragraphs: A small Streamlit app for looking up the price history of 11,700 US-listed stocks and ETFs. Pick a company and see the latest trading day's figures, a closing-price chart with a 1M / 6M / 1Y / 5Y / Max range picker, and trading volume. Data comes from Yahoo Finance via yfinance.
features: Financials view (when configured): real annual revenue, net income and earnings per share from the SEC's EDGAR data, a year-by-year chart, and links to the latest 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K filings.

News view: recent headlines for the company (from Yahoo Finance) with the source, how long ago, and a guessed topic, an optional AI summary of what bulls and bears are saying (each point cites the headlines it used), an…

Learn view: plain-English explainers that use the company on screen: how to read the numbers and charts, and how to read company reports (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, the three financial statements, earnings calls, with a link to…
Moving averages: switch on the 50-day and 200-day averages on the price chart.
Search: type a symbol or company name and press Enter; matches are ranked with exact symbols first.

whatItDoes.text: A small Streamlit app for looking up the price history of 11,700 US-listed stocks and ETFs. Pick a company and see the latest trading day's figures, a closing-price chart with a 1M / 6M / 1Y / 5Y / Max range picker, and trading volume. Data comes from Yahoo Finance via yfinance.

requirements.text: It reads three outside services (Yahoo Finance, the SEC, and optionally Anthropic's API) through caches, so a repeat view costs nothing and memory stays bounded.
